business_scope.primary_industry_name: Die-Struck Brass Cloisonné Polishing of Novelty Enamel Badges

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (unitary national system; Romano-Germanic tradition)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (in force 2012)
Colombia–Spain Agreement on the Promotion and Reciprocal Protection of Investments (2005, in force 2007)
Andean Community Decision 291 and Decision 578 (regional investment framework)
Colombia–United States Income Tax Convention (double taxation agreement)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 1258 of 2008 (S.A.S.), Law 526 of 1999 (UIAF), Law 1121 of 2006 (AML/CFT), Decreto 830 of 2021 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales — RUB), Superintendencia de Sociedades Resolution 2023-01-045103, and Circular Básica Jurídica of the Superintendencia de Sociedades (Capítulo X) as amended.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of passport (photocopy) for each shareholder and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the shareholder's/director's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization if the country is not party to the Hague Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing / legal existence for each corporate shareholder (if any)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or competent registrar of the shareholder's home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney for the legal representative / incorporator (denominado 'poder general o especial')
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the grantor's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Criminal record certificate (certificado de antecedentes judiciales) for the proposed legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National Police, court, or designated authority of the country of residence

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against OFAC SDN list, UN Security Council consolidated list, Colombian UIAF national PEP list, and domestic criminal/legal antecedents database; apply enhanced due diligence to PEPs and high-risk jurisdictions; continuous re-screening every calendar month and upon any triggering event, as required by Capítulo X of the Circular Básica Jurídica and the RUB rules.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) via the Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name must be stated in Spanish or be transliterated into Latin-script characters; all foreign-language tokens must have a certified Spanish translation; the official registered name must end with 'S.A.S.' or the full phrase 'Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada' in the supporting documents.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the requested name is rejected due to identical or confusingly similar registration, the applicant may file a reconsideration request (recurso de reposición) with the same Cámara de Comercio within 10 business days. If denied, a secondary appeal (recurso de apelación) may be lodged with the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio within 10 business days of the notification of the reconsideration decision, under the Código de Procedimiento Administrativo y de lo Contencioso Administrativo (Law 1437 of 2011). Alternatively, the applicant may select a new name and restart the clearance procedure.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office arrangement is permissible only if the service provider has a physically existing address in Colombia and the address is correctly declared as the domicilio social for service of process. A purely non-physical virtual address (e-mail or P.O. Box) is not acceptable for commercial registration; the address must correspond to a deliverable location and be regularly attended.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: For a low-risk, non-licensed manufacturer (ISIC 3240), the expected probability of an unannounced physical inspection in the first twelve months is approximately 5%–10%. The probability may increase to 15%–20% if UBO filings are incomplete, tax filings are inconsistent, or the company is selected by the Superintendencia de Sociedades for a compliance audit.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local Chamber of Commerce)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting and notarization of the S.A.S. constitutional document (private document or public deed)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial tariff and prevailing market legal fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial registration (matrícula mercantil) and inscription in the Registro Mercantil
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tariff based on subscribed capital

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-RUT and NIT formalities before DIAN
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) / Cámara de Comercio (authorized operator)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Administrative fee / statutory tariff for intermediate processing

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Submission of Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory compliance fee / professional assistance fee if outsourced

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille or consular legalization of foreign corporate and personal documents (three documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Colombian Ministry of Foreign Affairs / notary public in country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Government fee per apostille or consular service

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish translation of foreign documents (three documents)
AML/CFT due diligence, UBO piercing, and PEP/sanctions screening opinion
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External compliance counsel or law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for an outsourced compliance review

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Código de Comercio, Decree 410 of 1971, Book II, Title I, Articles 98-103; Law 1258 of 2008 (SAS), Articles 1-19; Decree 1074 of 2015, Single Regulatory Decree of Commerce, Industry and Tourism, Articles 1.1.1.1.1 - 1.2.1.1.1; Superintendencia de Sociedades Basic Legal Circular No. 100-000001 of 2021.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered domicile (administrator of the Registro Único Empresarial - RUES / Mercantile Registry) with corporate oversight by the Superintendencia de Sociedades.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation deed) or Escritura Pública No. ___ executed before a Notary only when in-kind real estate is contributed; filed and recorded in the Mercantile Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum legal capital. Authorized capital is freely set in the bylaws and divided into nominated shares; subscribed capital may be deferred up to two (2) years from registration of the incorporation deed. No escrow or blocked bank account is mandatory; the official registration stamp duty and Chamber tariff are approximately USD 45 for standard capital.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 001 OF THE SOLE FOUNDING SHAREHOLDER OF [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S. FIRST: Approve the subscription of the authorized capital. All subscribed shares are accepted and any unpaid balance shall be fully paid within twenty-four months from registration. SECOND: Adopt as the registered office the premises at [address], Colombia, and ratify the filing of the incorporation document with the Chamber of Commerce of [city]. THIRD: Appoint [NAME] as Manager and [NAME] as Deputy Manager with broad powers to execute filings, open bank accounts, apply for the tax registry and licenses, and represent the company generally. FOURTH: Authorize each officer to sign ancillary documents and take all actions necessary to complete the statutory incorporation of the company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name verification and reservation (Certificado de Homonimia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the chosen domicile - Registro Único Empresarial (RUES) online portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online name check to verify that the proposed corporate name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing company. On approval, the Chamber issues a Name Certificate reserving the name for the applicant. Complete the pre-registration RUES form and identify the SAS corporate purpose including CIIU code 3240 (manufacture of novelty badges and pins).
required_dossiers: Identity document of the founding shareholder
Intended corporate name (up to three alternatives)
Contact e-mail and address of the legal representative
Pre-registration RUES form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or conflicts with an existing trademark, modify the corporate name by adding a distinctive element and re-submit; the Chamber generally resolves the query within one business day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the private incorporation document (Documento Privado de Constitución)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding shareholders; an authorized Notaría Pública is required only if real estate or in-kind assets are contributed.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft and execute the incorporation deed containing: corporate name and domicile; precise corporate purpose covering die-struck brass, cloisonné enamelling, polishing and finishing of novelty lapel pins; capital table (authorized, subscribed and paid); company term; SAS governance rules; and appointment of the Manager and Deputy Manager. Each shareholder signs the document and fingerprints are captured on the original. If real estate forms part of the capital contribution, the deed must be executed before a notary public.
required_dossiers: Identity documents of the shareholders
Name certificate (Certificado de Homonimia)
Approved bylaws text including corporate purpose, capital subscription list, and governance clauses
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or Chamber observes defects in the bylaws, call a general meeting of shareholders, adopt a corrective amendment by majority resolution, and re-execute the document.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Chamber of Commerce (Registro Mercantil) and issuance of the Matrícula Mercantil
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio with jurisdiction over the registered office (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the incorporation document together with the RUES forms and proof that the Impuesto de Registro (registration tax on capital) and Derechos de Inscripción have been paid at the designated banking network or via the PSE online service. The Chamber records the company, issues the Matrícula Mercantil, opens the corporate file, and registers the company's official accounting books (libro de actas and libro de inventarios) before operations commence.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the incorporation document
Formulario Único de Registro (RUES)
Certificate of name reservation
Proof of payment of registration tax and Chamber fees
Identity card (cédula) of the legal representative
Address and land-use certificate of the registered office, if available
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is queried, the Chamber notifies the specific defect; the legal representative files a written correction with supporting evidence; once cured, the registration is effective retroactively to the presentation date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax identification: NIT, RUT, and electronic invoicing setup at DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Unidad Administrativa Especial Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - virtual portal (SIE).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following Chamber registration, log into DIAN's virtual office and apply for the NIT and RUT. Complete the economic activity form stating CIIU code 3240, corporate address, and the authorized representative's digital signature (Firma Electrónica). Select the tax obligations: corporate income tax (renta), industry and commerce tax (ICA), VAT or non-VAT status, and enable the electronic invoicing system (Factura Electrónica de Venta - FEV). Register the company's bank account data for tax refunds and download the RUT after 24-hour validation.
required_dossiers: Certificate of existence and legal representation issued by the Chamber of Commerce (not older than 3 months)
Identity document of the legal representative
RUT of shareholders when required
Proof of the corporate address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN presents data discrepancies or rejects the RUT, file a correction through DIAN's virtual office (trámite 1000) attaching the reconciled Chamber certificate; any RUT suspension is cured before invoicing is initiated.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate bank account opening and social security / occupational risk registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial banks (e.g., Bancolombia, Davivienda, BBVA) and administradoras: EPS (health), AFP (pension), ARL (occupational risk insurer), and Caja de Compensación Familiar.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate checking account in the company name using the Matrícula Mercantil and NIT/RUT. Register the company, legal representatives and all employees with the health EPS, pension fund, ARL (risk class II for light metal finishing manufacturing), and the Caja de Compensación. Notify the ARL of the use of chemical solvents and enamels; if the company has 10 or more workers, constitute the Joint Occupational Health Committee (COPASST).
required_dossiers: Matrícula Mercantil certificate of registration and existence
NIT and RUT certificates
Identity documents of legal representatives and authorized signatories
Corporate bank opening resolution and KYC forms
Payroll staff data and social security registration forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If bank opening is rejected for KYC, provide a certificate of no tax debts or a notarized compliance statement; remedy by selecting a second-tier bank or restarting with corrected corporate data.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal industrial and commercial registration (Registro de Industria y Comercio) and land-use clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Alcaldía Municipal - Oficina de Rentas de la Secretaría de Hacienda; Curaduría Urbana / Secretaría de Planeación for land-use certificates.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Registro de Industria y Comercio form for the industrial activity (CIIU 3240) at the municipal treasury office, together with the certified incorporation document, the lease or deed of the manufacturing site, the Certificado de Bomberos (fire safety), and the land-use certificate (Certificado de Uso del Suelo - CUS) confirming that industrial manufacturing is permissible at the address. Pay the annual ICA tax registration and obtain the certificado de registro público de actividades industriales.
required_dossiers: Company existence certificate
Land-use certificate (CUS)
Lease agreement or property title
Fire safety report issued by the Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos
Registro de Industria y Comercio form signed by the legal representative
Copy of the RUT and NIT
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Mayor's office denies the operating registration due to zoning, request a revision of the CUS or relocate the workshop to a permitted industrial zone; formal appeals must be filed within five (5) working days under Ley 1437 de 2011 (Administrative Litigation Code).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Alcaldía Municipal / Secretaría Distrital de Desarrollo Económico (industrial registry and operating authorization), coordinated with the Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) exercising environmental jurisdiction over the plant site.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro de Actividad Industrial y Comercial (Registro de Industria y Comercio) - CIIU 3240; operating authorization covered by the Certificado de Uso del Suelo and the Matrícula Mercantil.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) for national-level projects; for this small-scale artisanal manufacturing plant, the competent environmental authority is the regional Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) with jurisdiction over the plant site (e.g., CAR Cundinamarca for the Bogotá region).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 4 - Low Environmental Impact / Simplified Environmental Registry (Registro de Actividades de Bajo Impacto): a full Estudio de Impacto Ambiental or Diagnóstico Ambiental de Alternativas is NOT required. The unit must obtain an industrial wastewater discharge permit (Permiso de Vertimientos) and submit annual hazardous waste reports under Decree 1076 of 2015 and Resolución 0631 de 2015.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Industrial wastewater (Resolución 0631 de 2015): pH 6.00-9.00; BOD5 <= 200 mg/L; COD <= 300 mg/L; TSS <= 250 mg/L; hydrocarbons <= 10 mg/L; total chromium <= 0.5 mg/L; enamelling and degreasing baths must be segregated, neutralized and treated. Air emissions (Resolución 2254 de 2017): VOC emissions from acetone and enamel solvents must be captured via hoods and abated using activated carbon or catalytic oxidation, with annual NO2 <= 60 µg/m3 and SO2 <= 50 µg/m3; no fugitive solvent emissions permitted. Hazardous waste (enamel powders, metal finishing sludge, solvent residues) must be classified and stored under Decree 4741 de 2005, manifested, and transported exclusively by licensed carriers to authorized disposal facilities.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Certificado de Seguridad Humana y Protección Contra Incendios issued by the Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos (annual inspection, extinguishers, evacuation plan, and proper separation of solvent storage); structural load and electrical safety certificate issued by a licensed engineer and validated by the Curaduría Urbana; mandatory compliance with the national Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo (SG-SST) registered with the ARL, including medical surveillance for enamel dust and solvent vapor exposure.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) – official portal www.dian.gov.co; transactional platform MUISCA
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign-owned SAS obtains NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) upon incorporation via the Notary and Commercial Registry (Cámara de Comercio), followed by DIAN RUT (Registro Único Tributario) activation; the SAS must appoint a legal representative and, for e-invoicing, request an electronic invoicing certification. Non-resident shareholders do not require a local tax ID unless triggering Colombian source income.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation – SAS is a Colombian resident corporation; ordinary income taxed at entity level; no check-the-box pass-through regime for SAS.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election; optional 'Régimen Simple de Tributación' (SIMPLES) for qualifying SMEs with turnover <= 100,000 UVT and no excluded activities; hybrid mismatch rules under Law 2010/2019 limit deduction mismatches.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No COP turnover threshold for legal entities; VAT registration (activation of IVA responsibilities in RUT) is mandatory when the SAS carries out any activity subject to IVA. (Natural persons may be non-responsible only below 3,500 UVT; not applicable to SAS.)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (factura electrónica) through DIAN-authorized software or DIAN's free system; each invoice must include CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica), be transmitted in real time to DIAN via secure web services (API) and receive an acceptance/validation response before issuance to purchaser; failure to obtain DIAN acceptance invalidates the invoice for tax credit and deduction.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exports qualify for IVA zero-rating when: (1) the sale is made to a non-resident customer abroad; (2) goods physically leave Colombia within the term established by customs rules; (3) exporter is registered before DIAN and in the RUT with export activities; (4) export declaration (DEX) is accepted by DIAN customs authority. Offshore services used exclusively outside Colombia may also qualify under the 'exportation of services' regime where recipient has no Colombian activity (Decree 1625/2016, Arts 1.36.5.1.1 et seq.).
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación / DEX)
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Canalización de Divisas)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating is subject to intensive DIAN verification of the physical exit and foreign-currency repatriation. If requirements are not met within 180 days, DIAN can claw back zero-rating, assess IVA at 19% plus late interest, and impose fines under ET Arts 648 and 701 (up to 200% of the omitted tax in fraudulent cases); criminal smuggling/export fraud penalties under Law 1762/2015 may apply.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia / Autoridad Cambiaria)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a controlled-convertibility regime: current-account transactions (trade in goods and services) are freely convertible through authorized foreign-exchange intermediaries; capital-account operations require prior registration with the Banco de la República Foreign Investment Registry. Profit remittances from a registered foreign investment are permitted upon presentation of the international capital registration certificate and compliance with the applicable exchange declaration. Practical hurdles include documentary formality, mandatory channeling through the foreign exchange market, and a 5% remittance tax when the statutory trigger applies (Law 2277 of 2022). The Colombian peso (COP) is convertible for settlement of all bona fide trade-related flows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds from goods (ISIC 3240 enamel pins) must be repatriated to Colombia through the foreign exchange market within the legally prescribed term of 6 months from the date of customs export dispatch; service-related proceeds follow the 6-month service-rendering window. Once received, proceeds must be negotiated (surrendered) via an authorized intermediary and converted into local currency (COP) unless an exemption is granted (e.g., permissible foreign-currency deposit account for recurring export flows, or offsetting under a compensation agreement). Extension requests must be filed before the statutory deadline with the Banco de la República.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Current Account (Cuenta Corriente) / Capital Escrow Account (Cuenta de Remesas de Capital)
Operational Current Account / Export Collection USD Account (Cuenta en Moneda Extranjera)
Operational Current Account / Capital Escrow Account
Operational Current Account / USD Deposit Account
Operational Current Account / FX Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW-MEDIUM. Offshore digital EMIs and fintech payment providers (including Etsy Direct Pay or Stripe counterparty banks) cannot legally open Colombian local treasury accounts unless domiciled and licensed as a Sociedad Especializada en Depósitos y Pagos Electrónicos (SEDPE) or operate through a regulated local correspondent bank. Cross-border USD settlement must route through an authorized local intermediary (tier-1 bank) that accepts foreign marketpay proceeds and performs the exchange declaration. A pure offshore EMI cannot serve as the exclusive treasury rail without violating the foreign-exchange channeling obligations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Colombian banks generally require the physical or virtual presence of the legal representative (and often a principal shareholder / ultimate beneficial owner) for the final KYC interview. Virtual onboarding is permitted under FOSGA/SFC guidelines using biometric video identification, but requires a notarized power of attorney if the director is outside Colombia. Fully remote opening without any in-person or notarized step remains impractical and carries high rejection risk.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume online marketplace export revenue with no physical retail footprint and multiple foreign counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Platform settlement reports (Etsy Direct Pay / Stripe) for the past 12 months; order-level commercial invoices; shipping carrier bills of lading; customs export declarations (DEX); tax authority solicitud de autorización de facturación; and a written AML risk self-assessment under Sarlaft.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opacity in the corporate ownership chain (non-resident shareholders, tiered trust structures)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled/certified register of ultimate beneficial owners; notarized certificate of shareholding; resolution of the general assembly identifying the treasury signatories; passports and proof of residence of all UBOs; current extract of the Cámara de Comercio.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bank account purpose mismatch with nominal ISIC 3240 classification
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Production and sourcing contracts for enamel pin dies, brass blanks, and packaging; laboratory or hallmark certificates; commercial agreement with logistics consolidators; and a written invoice/payment flow map matching ISIC 3240 to physical merchandise.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sudden, lumpy FX conversion activity inconsistent with the company's registered working capital and projected cash flow
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Historical Etsy/Stripe payout statements; monthly treasury reconciliation; projected export cash-flow model; export warehouse delivery notes; and confirmation of prior foreign exchange declarations (Declaración de Cambio) filed with the intermediary.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity capital injection must be wired via SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's account to the local bank's correspondent account, with benefit field specifying the CO_SAS treasury account. The remittance must carry the Banco de la República purpose code for direct investment ('Inversión Directa en Colombia – Moneda Libre') and a reference to the company's registered foreign investment ID. Before the wire, the investor must file the international investment form (Form 3 / Indicador de Capital) and obtain the registration number; the local bank enforces documentary matching prior to conversion into COP.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade payments (raw material imports for die-struck brass and enamel production) settle by SWIFT MT103 for open-account transactions or through a commercial documentary letter of credit (UCP600) for established supplier relationships. All outbound disbursements must be reported by the bank in the monthly foreign-exchange declaration (Declaración de Cambio) and require supporting invoice, bill of lading, and DIAN import declaration (Declaración de Importación) to substantiate the business purpose.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable forward USD/COP (used to hedge committed export receivables and import payables; executed with an authorized FX intermediary and documented with an underlying trade exposure)

Non-deliverable forward (NDF) with an offshore counterparty (permissible for COP/USD hedging under the Banco de la República hedge exception, provided the hedge is not speculative and is linked to the commercial cash-flow exposure)
Cross-currency swap USD/COP (permissible for long-term capital and operational refinancing, with prior registration and economic hedging justification)
FX swap (spot-start) for converting short-term export proceeds into COP with a simultaneous forward leg, limited to current-account liquidity matching

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual commercial registry renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil) of the S.A.S.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio principal (Colombian Chamber of Commerce at the registered legal domicile)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Fixed calendar window from 1 January to 31 March of each year, regardless of incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers Chamber of Commerce late-renewal penalties and loss of 'renovated' registry status; continued non-renewal can lead to cancellation of the commercial registration and administrative strike-off of the S.A.S.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval and registration of annual financial statements, management report (informe de gestión), and ordinary shareholders' meeting minutes (acta de asamblea)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Commercial Registry) after shareholder approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Ordinary shareholders' meeting must approve year-end financial statements within three months of the fiscal year-end; for a 31 December year-end, by 31 March. Approved minutes and financial statements must be filed with the Commercial Registry within 30 days of approval, generally no later than 30 April.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file exposes the S.A.S. and its legal representative to fines from the Superintendencia de Sociedades, impairs Chamber of Commerce certificates, prevents clean registry renewal, and may lead to administrative dissolution upon persistent non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial-owner confirmation and exogenous information return (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales / RUBF update included in Información Exógena)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the date assigned by DIAN's published schedule based on the last digit of the NIT, generally within the first semester following the tax year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Omission or late filing is penalized under Article 651 of the Colombian Tax Code; recurring non-compliance may suspend the taxpayer's RUT and impose personal liability on the legal representative.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios) of the S.A.S.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the date assigned by DIAN based on the last two digits of the NIT; the exact window is set each year by DIAN regulation and normally falls within the first semester for calendar-year-end legal entities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing accrues monthly extemporaneity penalties and interest on any tax due; significant or repeated omissions can trigger DIAN assessment procedures, asset seizure measures, and restriction from obtaining certificates for foreign trade or public contracts.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A S.A.S. must appoint a Revisor Fiscal (statutory auditor) if total assets at 31 December equal or exceed 5,000 SMLMV or gross income equals or exceeds 3,000 SMLMV; the requirement also applies to parent/subordinated entities and entities subject to superintendence oversight. A small enamel-pin manufacturer below these thresholds is not legally required to obtain an independent statutory audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Colombia under Law 1314 of 2009 and Decree 2420 of 2015; a small non-listed S.A.S. generally applies IFRS for SMEs (Group 2) or the simplified micro-entity accounting framework (Group 3) if eligible.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: All quota or share transfers must be annotated in the Register of Members before they can be relied upon against the S.A.S. The annual ordinary shareholders' meeting confirms the updated membership and beneficial-ownership records; the legal representative also confirms ultimate beneficial-owner data in the DIAN RUBF and annual exogenous information filing. Any mid-year change in beneficial ownership must be declared to DIAN within the RUBF update term established by DIAN, commonly ten business days.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors (Registro de Miembros de Junta Directiva)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 if no statutory audit applies below the mandatory thresholds; voluntary certified audit typically USD 2,000 – USD 6,500 per year for a low-asset S.A.S.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (Impuesto sobre la Renta y Complementarios – national corporate income tax; no municipal or departmental corporate income tax applies)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general sectoral tax holiday exists for ISIC 3240 enamel pin manufacturing or export merchandising activities. Effective rate reductions are available only through lawful deductions, including cost of goods sold, export-related logistics, depreciation of die-stamping and enamelling equipment, employee payroll costs, and VAT input credit on goods exported. A preferential immediate deduction for certified investments in innovation and creative-industry projects may apply if the SAS obtains formal DIAN/certification approval. The standard effective rate for a profitable, non-exempt SAS therefore remains 35% before application of any qualifying deductions or tax credits.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 110 – Declaración de Renta y Complementarios; mandatory electronic filing via the DIAN MUISCA portal and authorized transmission software at www.dian.gov.co.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; one income tax return per fiscal year. Monthly accrual filings for VAT and withholding taxes remain separately due through Form 300 and Form 350 as applicable.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For a calendar-year SAS, the annual Form 110 is due between 20 September and 10 October of the following year, subject to the DIAN staggered calendar keyed to the last two digits of the NIT. For a non-calendar fiscal year, the due date is established by DIAN resolution with reference to the ninth month after the year-end. No automatic extension exists; failure to abide by the assigned due date triggers late-filing penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 / Header – NIT, Razon Social, RUT verification, Año Gravable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identifies the SAS as the taxpayer, its Colombian tax identification number, registered business name, updated RUT classification, and the taxable year covered by the return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The foreign founders or shareholders are not identified on this header; the Colombian SAS is the sole taxpayer. The non-resident shareholder must nevertheless be shown in the DIAN beneficial ownership annex and transactional annexes if a foreign related party exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All gross operating revenue from sale of hard enamel lapel pins, including Etsy Direct Pay settlements and Stripe gross proceeds before platform commission, merchant fees, and shipping refunds. Foreign-source export income is includible because the SAS is a Colombian tax resident on worldwide income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For the SAS, record all Colombian and foreign sales in COP using the DIAN representative exchange rate on the date the entitlement arises. The personal accounts of non-resident shareholders are not relevant unless the shareholder conducts the SAS business through a deemed permanent establishment in Colombia.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of enamel pin blanks, die-struck brass, cloisonné enamelling materials, subcontract polishing costs, logistics warehousing, Stripe and Etsy fees, marketing payments, payroll, and depreciation of equipment. Each cost must be documented with valid invoices and, where applicable, bank payment records.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions are allowed only if expenses have a direct causal relationship with taxable income, are economically necessary, and are supported in Colombia. Payments to overseas related suppliers require transfer-pricing documentation if the transaction exceeds the relevant threshold, and cross-border royalties or technical-service fees must have had domestic withholding applied at source.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Renglón 47 – Renta Liquida / Compensación de Pérdidas
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computes net liquid income after cost and deduction offsets. Fiscal losses are carried forward and offset against future taxable net income for a maximum of 12 taxable years.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Operating losses belong to the Colombian entity and cannot be allocated or distributed to foreign shareholders. Losses do not reduce any personal or withholding obligation of a non-resident shareholder.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Renglón 59/73 – Rentas Exentas / Renta Liquida Gravable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applies any certified statutory exemption and then converts the remaining income into taxable net income. A standard SAS engaged in non-licensed enamel badge manufacturing generally has no automatic exemption.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exemption status is entity-specific. A non-resident shareholder cannot claim a proportionate exemption on Colombian-source distributions unless the applicable income tax treaty expressly assigns the taxable right to the foreign jurisdiction under the tie-breaker rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Renglón 80 – Impuesto a Cargo, Retenciones y Anticipo
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calculates the 35% national income tax on taxable net income, applies prepaid monthly anticipatory tax balances and any creditable foreign tax on export operations, and produces the final tax payable or balance in favor.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders are not allowed to use entity-level credits against their dividend withholding tax. The final CIT liability of the SAS is settled through the DIAN bank network; any distribution later made to a non-resident shareholder will be subject to separate dividend withholding tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late submission of Form 110 under ET Article 641 triggers a lump-sum fine of 5% of the tax due for each month or fraction of month of delay, capped at 100% of the tax due; where no tax is payable, the penalty is 1% of gross income. Additional moratory interest accrues on unpaid income tax at the DIAN interest rate. Failure to file after a DIAN administrative notice can increase the penalty and allow immediate tax enforcement, asset seizure, and embargo of bank accounts.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% as the final withholding tax on dividends paid to non-resident shareholders out of profits that have already been subject to Colombian corporate income tax at the entity level. Dividends out of profits not previously taxed at the entity level are recharacterized and subject to the ordinary 35% rate at the company level before distribution.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: A non-resident shareholder wishing to invoke a lower rate under a Colombian double-taxation agreement must furnish the Colombian payer with a valid Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) issued by the competent foreign tax authority, a properly completed beneficial-ownership statement, and, where required, a DIAN treaty-relief application submitted through the withholding agent. The reduced rate is applied at source only if the shareholder is the beneficial owner, does not have a permanent establishment in Colombia through which the shares are connected, meets limitation-on-benefits conditions, and supplies the documentation before the dividend payment is made. The withholding agent must retain the supporting dossier for at least five years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory withholding on cross-border royalties for industrial patents, trademarks, designs, and know-how is 20%, while qualifying debt interest paid to non-residents is generally 15%; higher rates of 20% to 35% may apply to interest on loans from related parties if the financing lacks bank registration or fails the thin-capitalization test. Treaty jurisdictions commonly reduce royalty withholding to 5% to 10% and interest withholding to 10% to 15%, provided the beneficial-owner and TRC conditions are met. Payments to Etsy or Stripe for platform services are treated separately from royalties; platform transaction fees are generally business-service fees subject to VAT and, where rendered from abroad, the corresponding technical-services withholding rules if applicable.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory transfer-pricing documentation (Local File) is triggered for tax year 2025 when gross income, total assets, or net equity exceeds 135,000 UVT, approximately COP 6,674,290,000, or when related-party transactions with foreign enterprises exceed 45,000 UVT, approximately COP 2,224,430,000. Master File documentation becomes mandatory for multinational groups that meet the DIAN consolidated gross revenue threshold, and Country-by-Country reporting applies only to groups with consolidated revenues above the substantially higher BEPS threshold.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia has not enacted a standalone Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) code comparable to offshore financial centers. Nevertheless, substantive-compliance doctrines are embedded in Colombian tax law through substance-over-form, general anti-avoidance rules, controlled-foreign-company rules, and DIAN's power to disregard legal entities lacking economic reality. A SAS producing and selling enamel lapel pins must maintain a local registered office, employees or contractors, board minutes, banking records, export invoices, and actual decision-making in Colombia to confirm tax residence and to defend deductions, treaty access, and limited liability.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately omitting Etsy Direct Pay and Stripe proceeds from Form 110, recording personal household expenses as corporate deductions, issuing false cost invoices from nonexistent polish suppliers, or using an undisclosed foreign bank account to receive export proceeds without recording the receivable on the Colombian books.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative inexactness penalty of 100% of the additional tax determined by DIAN, plus moratory interest at the monthly DIAN rate. If the evaded tax exceeds 100 legal monthly minimum wages, the conduct also qualifies as criminal tax evasion under the Criminal Code, carrying imprisonment of 48 to 108 months and a fine of up to 100% of the evaded amount.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced when the S.A.S. is used as a mere instrument of fraud. The managing director and legal representative who signs the false return are jointly and severally liable for the CIT debt, loss of the tax clearance certificate, judicial freezing of personal assets, an exit-delay order preventing international travel, and imprisonment for criminal evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Importing raw brass enamel blanks or subcontracting enamelling/polishing from a foreign related enterprise at prices outside the arm's-length range, failing to file the transfer-pricing annex and Local File at the mandatory threshold, or preparing no comparability analysis despite cross-border controlled transactions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN may adjust the taxable income upward, impose the 35% tax on the adjusted amount, disallow deductions where documentation is absent, and apply a transfer-pricing fine for non-filing or defective filing of the statutory documentation. Interest and exactness penalties enlarge the assessment; intentional TP manipulation may also be prosecuted as fraudulent tax reporting.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly execute or approve non-arm's-length related-party transactions are jointly liable for the tax and penalties arising from the adjustment. Recidivism in failing to file required documentation exposes the legal representative to personal fines and to criminal tax-fraud liability if the adjustment exceeds the threshold for prosecution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the SAS as a paper entity with no physical presence, no employees, no local bank account, no stock records, and no commercial contracts, while the true accounting, marketing, and management decisions are conducted by a foreign resident outside Colombia and profits are immediately stripped as remittances or fake commissions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN may recharacterize the entity as a tax resident of the foreign shareholders' country or deny the SAS loss and deduction claims under the general anti-abuse doctrine. Treaty benefits are rejected, the constitutive-limited-liability protection is weakened, and the foreign remittance is subjected to the full Colombian withholding rates applicable to undisclosed technical assistance, royalties, or constructive dividends.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The shareholders and appointed manager may be held jointly and severally liable for all unpaid taxes and penalties when lack of substance proves that the corporate form was an abuse of law. Travel bans, bank-account embargoes, and commercial disqualification apply to the officers; positive evidence of fraud converts the assessment into a criminal shell-company prosecution with imprisonment exposure.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to register and update the final beneficial owner of the SAS before DIAN, accepting unexplained Stripe or Etsy settlements without corresponding commercial invoices, using the enamel-pin export line to move funds despite no physical shipment, or structuring share transfers solely to avoid Colombian dividend withholding through a foreign intermediate entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines for non-compliance with Colombian UBO registration rules, regulatory penalties for failure to implement money-laundering prevention measures under the AML framework, possible revocation of access to regulated e-money payment rails, administrative seizure of unexplained assets, and criminal money-laundering charges where the transaction represented an attempt to hide the illegal origin or true beneficiary of funds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil does not shelter the responsible manager in AML matters. Officers and shareholders who knowingly handle suspicious proceeds face criminal liability, fines in proportion to the laundered assets, and imprisonment of up to 30 years. The S.A.S. may be blacklisted and dissolved by judicial order when the legal entity is determined to be a vehicle for illicit financial flows.
